Create Patient.description: Registers a new Patient resource from an incoming registration record.

Create Observation.description: Records a vital sign or lab result as an Observation linked to a patient.

Create Immunization.description: Records a vaccine dose given to a patient.

Create Encounter.description: Logs a clinic visit as an Encounter for a patient.

Submit Transaction Bundle.description: Creates a patient and their encounter together in one atomic transaction.

Submit Claim For Adjudication.description: Posts a Claim to the server's $submit operation.

Get Patient By ID.description: Reads a single Patient resource by its logical id.
Get Patient By ID.code:
// Read one Patient by id.
get(`Patient/${$.data.patientId}`);

Search Patients By Identifier.description: Finds patients matching a national ID or other business identifier.

Search Recently Updated Observations.description: Pulls observations changed since the last sync, newest first.

Get Patient Everything.description: Fetches a patient's full record (encounters, observations, etc.) with $everything.

Get Claims With Patients.description: Lists recent Claims and includes the referenced Patient resources.

Search Immunizations For Patient.description: Lists the vaccines a patient has received.
